formal_role: Defines the external input applied to the dynamic system
systems_modeling_role: Represents shock intervention stress seasonality policy or disturbance
review_warning: The forcing function should be justified and documented

formal_role: Identifies when the external disturbance occurs
systems_modeling_role: Determines whether the system is shocked during a stable or fragile state
review_warning: Timing assumptions can strongly affect response and recovery

formal_role: Defines the size of the external disturbance
systems_modeling_role: Represents severity intensity intervention strength or loss
review_warning: Magnitude should include units scaling and scenario rationale

formal_role: Controls how quickly the system returns toward a reference state
systems_modeling_role: Represents resilience repair adaptation damping or institutional response
review_warning: Recovery-rate estimates should not be treated as universal constants

formal_role: Measures deviation loss recovery time overshoot or threshold crossing
systems_modeling_role: Defines what counts as impact or resilience
review_warning: Different metrics can support different conclusions

formal_role: Defines why the driver is treated as external
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies which causes are inside or outside the model scope
review_warning: External forcing may become endogenous in a larger model
